[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/cli_bash.lani#L4)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Pure measured NUL-record completion reply encoder over borrowed data and caller output. It preflights mode consistency, ranges, NUL and complete capacity, preserving output on error; quote/continuation/trim metadata is transported without applying shell insertion policy. Pure contracts and the 389-record decoder/reply model execute on native Linux x86_64. The separate Bash 5.2/bash-completion 2.11 adapter owns filesystem enumeration, host bounds and literal Readline insertion; finite function/PTY and watchdog gates pass on the linked host profile. Host glob allocations/enumeration time remain outside Lanius source caps; direct receipts are not Rust-libtest passes.
